title: create
description: Formal spec §7.3. The first operation of a did:guardian identity's log (REQ-7-3).

did.description: REQ-7-7/REQ-7-8: the DID of the identity this creates.

keys.description: REQ-7-8: sets the initial `keys` -- 1 to 8 distinct Multikey strings (REQ-6-1/REQ-5-8).

guardians.description: REQ-7-8: sets the initial `guardians` -- 0 to 32 entries with distinct DIDs (REQ-6-1).

services.description: REQ-7-8: sets the initial `services` -- 0 to 32 services with distinct `id` values (REQ-6-1).

alsoKnownAs.description: REQ-7-8: sets the initial `alsoKnownAs` -- 0 to 32 distinct URIs (REQ-6-1).

proof.description: REQ-7-6: every key in `keys`, every key in each entry in `guardians`, and every key in `successor` if it is an entry.

attestation.description: REQ-7-7/REQ-7-9: required unless `did` names a root identity, forbidden if it does.

critical.description: REQ-7-30: optional, non-empty list of distinct extension names (each an absolute URI per RFC 3986, REQ-7-29), each a member of `policy.extensions`.

extensions.description: REQ-5-3/REQ-7-29: optional. Each member name is an absolute URI.
